points.description: States that the statement is FALSE.
Justification: in a pipe, writing is done only on fd[1] (write end).
points.partial_credit: Half if only says fd[0] and fd[1] have different roles without naming fd[1] as write end.

points.description: Justification: reading is done only from fd[0] (read end); so writing to fd[0] or reading from fd[1] is not valid.
points.partial_credit: Half if read end named vaguely or only implied by the fd[1] statement.

rubric.notes: Full marks need FALSE plus a correct justification: fd[0] is the read end and fd[1] is the write end, so the reverse use is not allowed. Give part marks if only one end's role is correct or the roles are stated vaguely. If the answer says TRUE, or the justification is missing or wrong, give 0 overall, since no correct justification means no marks.
